tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Send a fax to a US or Canada fax number with Dimefax (10¢ a page, no subscription, no account needed first). Give the document as base64 (PDF, PNG or JPEG), as a public https link to one, or as the plain text of a letter you wrote. This prepares the fax and returns a link for the user: they check it

tools.name: fax_status
tools.description: How a fax set up with send_fax is going: waiting for payment, sending, trying again, delivered, or why it didn’t go through.
